data.description:
## Context (placeholder; full brainstorm pending)

Once Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (cycle-end arbiter + workflow unification) is live, the arbiter will create unparented `task` tickets tagged `defer` for unresolved findings that don't meet the blocking floor. Other DSO surfaces will also produce orphan tasks per the same convention:

- `/dso:fix-bug` Phase G antipattern-scan candidates (origin:antipattern-scan)
- PR-comment defer classifications via `/dso:respond-to-pr-comments` (origin:pr-followup)
- Manually-filed maintenance / tech-debt items (origin:tech-debt)

These tasks accumulate as a kanban-style "needs attention but not urgent" backlog. They are NOT defects (so don't flow through `/dso:fix-bug`) and NOT planned features (so don't flow through `/dso:sprint`). Without a dedicated consumer, the backlog grows indefinitely.

This epic delivers `/dso:cleanup` — the skill that processes this backlog.

## Scope (to be brainstormed)

Likely components:
- Triage interface: lists orphan tasks grouped by `origin:*` provenance tag; surfaces staleness, file overlap, related-finding clusters
- Per-task disposition: **act now** (dispatch sub-agent to implement), **defer further** (refresh tag / re-prioritize), **drop** (delete ticket with audit log), **promote to epic** (invoke `/dso:brainstorm` with the task description as seed)
- Bulk operations: process all tasks of a given origin in one pass; cluster related findings before dispatch
- Integration with sub-agent dispatch and review/commit workflows so "act now" follows the same TDD / review-gate discipline as regular task work
- Optional: scheduled summary report ("you have N tasks tagged defer across M origins; oldest is X days old")

Open questions for brainstorm:
- How does triage UX work in an autonomous-resolver context (no human present)?
- What's the right batch size? Process one task per invocation, or work through a batch?
- How does `/dso:cleanup` interact with sprint? (e.g., can it run as a pre-sprint step?)
- Should there be a priority/aging model so oldest tasks surface first?
- How does the skill avoid acting on tasks that are blocked by an active in-progress epic?

## Conventions consumed (defined by Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 deliverable)

- Ticket type `task` with `parent_id = null` is allowed for orphan work items
- Provenance tags: `origin:arbiter`, `origin:antipattern-scan`, `origin:pr-followup`, `origin:tech-debt`, etc.
- Intent tags: `defer` signals "real work, not urgent, not part of an active epic"
- Convention documented in `plugins/dso/docs/` by Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839

## Dependencies

`depends_on` Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (`swap-maple-flyby` — cycle-end arbiter + workflow unification). Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 ships the convention and the first producer of orphan tasks; `/dso:cleanup` is the consumer.

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>` after Epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 ships.
